---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure or incorrect replay result
title: ''
---

For security vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md and contact pm@xternet.dev
privately. Redact secrets, private payloads, account data and local paths.

## Environment

Version/commit, OS/architecture, runtime family and worker/bundle hashes.

## Reproduce

Minimal command or code, input mode (prepared/captured/live), and steps.
Include only sanitized inputs you are authorized to share.

## Expected / actual result

Include the typed error/outcome and relevant redacted receipt fields.
State whether the original control or modified execution differed and whether
the request used overrides, traces or cache. Include source pins when available.
